interactive.label: Compute
interactive.tooltip: Recompute the FCS curves, the one-component and two-component fits, the radial profiles and the power sweeps from the current kinetics and optics. The plots also follow every edit.

interactive.label: Load scheme
interactive.tooltip: Load a photophysical scheme (states, labels, transition rates and brightness) from a JSON file.

interactive.label: Save scheme
interactive.tooltip: Export the state labels, every non-zero transition rate and the brightness as a JSON scheme file.

interactive.label: Load session
interactive.tooltip: Restore the optics, kinetics and display settings saved by Save session.

interactive.label: Save session
interactive.tooltip: Save the optics, kinetics and display settings to the per-user settings file, which is read again when the tool starts.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: A step-by-step walk through a worked example: Rhodamine 6G at 488 nm.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain saturation, the scheme matrices and how to read the curves.

interactive.label: power_mW
interactive.tooltip: Total laser power measured at the objective (mW). It sets the photon flux and with it the peak excitation rate k_exc(0,0) = 2 sigma Phi / (pi w_r^2). At 0 the saturated curve is exactly the unsaturated Gaussian. Type a value or use the arrows.

interactive.label: power_log.slider
interactive.tooltip: The same power on a logarithmic scale from 0.001 to 100 mW (the exponent is shown), because the interesting range spans decades.

interactive.label: wavelength_nm
interactive.tooltip: Excitation wavelength. It sets the photon energy, so the same power delivers more photons at longer wavelengths, and the extinction read from a chosen dye.

interactive.label: Bunching dynamics
interactive.tooltip: Include the photokinetic bunching factor in the saturated curve: the relaxation of the scheme on the diffusion timescale.

interactive.label: n_states
interactive.tooltip: Number of states of the scheme. Two is the minimum (ground and excited); add one for each dark, isomeric or bleached state.

interactive.label: K_dark (1/us), row to column
interactive.tooltip: The power-independent transitions between states. Row is the state a transition starts from, column where it ends.

interactive.label: K_exc cross-sections, row to column
interactive.tooltip: Excitation transitions relative to the peak excitation rate; 1 means a full cross-section.

interactive.label: State brightness Q
interactive.tooltip: Relative fluorescence emitted by each state; dark states have zero.

interactive.label: State diagram
interactive.tooltip: Show State diagram.

interactive.label: FCS curve
interactive.tooltip: Show FCS curve.

interactive.label: Info
interactive.tooltip: Show Info.

interactive.label: Volume profile
interactive.tooltip: Show Volume profile.

interactive.label: Volume(P)
interactive.tooltip: Show Volume(P).

interactive.label: Diffusion time
interactive.tooltip: Show Diffusion time.

interactive.label: Normalize G(τ) to 1.0
interactive.tooltip: Scale both curves to G(0) = 1 to compare their shapes: the saturated curve is not only smaller but broader.

interactive.label: 1-component fit
interactive.tooltip: Overlay the best single-component 3D Gaussian fit of the saturated curve, what a standard FCS analysis would report.
